verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own docs say Brain² answers complex questions by checking your workspace, connected apps and the web, and that it sees tasks, docs and conversations in real time. That covers the core 'ask AI about my workspace' part of the story. However, nothing in the evidence shows answers come with citations or source links back to workspace content, and the claims are marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documented source citations in answers, detail on answer speed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
